en: A black‑and‑white view over a small ornamental pond in a park or garden, bordered by low fencing and dense vegetation. Mature trees frame the image, and across a street in the background stands a row of European‑style town buildings with shopfronts and awnings. One façade clearly bears the word "PHOTOGRAPH" indicating a photography studio; other vertical and horizontal shop signs are visible but too blurred to read. The scene has an old‑fashioned, early‑20th‑century appearance typical of real‑photo postcards.
